Class KeyValuesFormatterBuilder

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesFormatterBuilder
public final class KeyValuesFormatterBuilder extends Object
Builds a LogFormatter that appends event key values percent encoded, or as JSON, JSON5, or logfmt text, directly to a StringBuilder. The default writes all keys percent encoded, preserving their order, which reads back exactly with PercentCodec.decode(CharSequence, java.nio.charset.Charset). In JSON and JSON5 non-null values are always strings, even when they look like numbers, booleans, or JSON.

Compose it with other formatters through LogFormatter.Builder.keyValues(java.util.function.Consumer), or LogFormatter.Builder.add(LogFormatter) with a built formatter: 

LogFormatter formatter = LogFormatter.builder()
	.message()
	.text(" ")
	.add(new KeyValuesFormatterBuilder().format(KeyValuesFormatterBuilder.Format.JSON5)
		.nullStrategy(LogFormatter.KeyValueNullStrategy.SKIP)
		.build())
	.newline()
	.build();

JSON and JSON5 results include braces, including {} when no keys are written; percent encoding and logfmt have no braces and write nothing when no keys are written. The builder is mutable; each built formatter is immutable and thread-safe.

  • Method Details

    • keys

      public KeyValuesFormatterBuilder keys(List<String> keys)
      Selects the keys to write, in the supplied order. The list is copied and duplicate keys are written once at their first position. An empty list writes {}. Missing selected keys follow the null strategy, just like keys mapped to null.
      Parameters:
      keys - keys to select.
      Returns:
      this builder.

    • allKeys

      public KeyValuesFormatterBuilder allKeys()
      Selects all keys, in the order supplied by the event's key values. This is the default and resets a previous keys(List) selection.
      Returns:
      this builder.

    • nullStrategy

      public KeyValuesFormatterBuilder nullStrategy(LogFormatter.KeyValueNullStrategy nullStrategy)
      Controls null values, and missing keys when a selection is supplied: LogFormatter.KeyValueNullStrategy.KEEP writes null (logfmt: key=, percent encoding: the key alone), LogFormatter.KeyValueNullStrategy.EMPTY writes an empty string, and LogFormatter.KeyValueNullStrategy.SKIP omits the key. The default is KEEP.
      Parameters:
      nullStrategy - null value strategy.
      Returns:
      this builder.

    • format

      public KeyValuesFormatterBuilder format(KeyValuesFormatterBuilder.Format format)

      Parameters:
